themes.name: Agents leave the lab
themes.blurb: Models that plan, use tools and work for hours are the main product bet. Coding is where it works best so far. Business workflows follow, and controls for what agents may do trail behind.

themes.name: Chips, power and the race
themes.blurb: Progress is bought with chips and electricity. That pulls data centres, export controls, power grids and national strategy into the AI story.

themes.name: Does it actually work?
themes.blurb: Adoption runs ahead of measurement. Benchmarks saturate, productivity studies disagree, and regulated fields ask for trials before trusting results.

themes.name: Who sets the rules
themes.blurb: Legislators, courts, regulators and licensing deals are each writing part of the rulebook, often at different speeds and in different directions.

themes.name: Understanding the machine
themes.blurb: What is happening inside a model, whether it can be trusted to hold to its goals, and what, if anything, it is like to be one. Empirical research meets philosophy here.

themes.name: AI as a scientist
themes.blurb: From protein design to proofs and weather forecasts, models are moving from analysing results to proposing and running the experiments.

themes.name: People, work and trust
themes.blurb: How AI changes jobs, learning, relationships and what people believe. The effects are real but uneven, and the evidence is still coming in.

lenses.name: Software engineer
lenses.blurb: The tools changing how software is written, reviewed, tested and run, plus the agent research and protocols underneath them.

lenses.name: Business or product leader
lenses.blurb: Where agents are being deployed in companies, what the returns look like, and the rules and workforce questions that come with them.

lenses.name: ML researcher
lenses.blurb: The research frontier itself, the sciences it is being tested on, and the debates about where it leads.

lenses.name: Scientist
lenses.blurb: AI as an instrument for discovery, the reasoning and robotics research behind it, and how results are checked.

lenses.name: Lawyer or compliance lead
lenses.blurb: AI inside legal practice, and the law being written about AI: statutes, court rulings, licensing and sector rules.

lenses.name: Policy or strategy analyst
lenses.blurb: Compute, power, national strategy and governance, with the safety research and economic debates that inform them.

lenses.name: Educator or learner
lenses.blurb: Tutors, assessment and policy in education, and what research says about learning with AI.

lenses.name: Clinician or health researcher
lenses.blurb: AI in diagnosis, documentation, drug development and patient use, and how it is validated and regulated.

lenses.name: Artist, writer or media maker
lenses.blurb: Generative tools across image, video, music, writing and games, and the fights over training data, pay and provenance.

lenses.name: Philosopher or humanist
lenses.blurb: Questions about mind, knowledge, values and work, and the technical research that bears on them.
